Theme

Latin word

alius

alius, alia, aliud

adjective and pronoun; dat. aliī; for the genitive alterīus is usual

another, a different one; other, different; else, other; other; in the plural, others, other things

In this lexicon

  • another

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. And. 670: aliā aggrediēmur viā; Cic. Q. fr. 3.1.19: nē mīrēre aliā manū esse

  • different

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. Ph. 684: aliud mihi respondēs ac rogō?; Sall. Cat. 6.2: alius aliō mōre vīventēs; Ter. And. 189: nunc hic diēs aliam vītam affert, aliōs mōrēs postulat

  • else

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. Eun. 191: numquid vīs aliud?; Tac. Dial. 29.3: quī domī quicquam aliud loquātur; Traupman 309

  • other

    the recommended word · classical · Hor. S. 2.4.21: aliīs male crēditur; Ov. Ars 3.121: prīsca juvent aliōs

  • alius alium: each other

    classical

Examples

  • Hāc nōn successit, aliā aggrediēmur viā.

    That way didn’t work; we’ll try another.Ter. And. 670
